author: CipherSecurityN
text: Cisco says attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-76418 (CVSS 8.6) in Secure Firewall ASA and FTD: an unauthenticated DoS that reloads devices via the Remote Access SSL VPN when secondary auth is set on a tunnel group. No workarounds; patch now.

author: thesystemprompt
text: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team: an unreleased Claude model chained 4 bugs for one-click RCE in Chrome (62 CVEs, all critical/high, fixed in Chrome 156), bypassed Safari's same-origin policy, and got zero-click root on Linux via multipath TCP.

author: CisoMarketplace
text: Arista: attackers are actively exploiting a 9.9-rated SQL injection in VeloCloud Orchestrator, letting a read-only account become superuser. Third exploited VCO zero-day in four months, 10,000+ customers affected.

author: helixml
text: Cisco Talos: UAT-11473 exploited Catalyst SD-WAN auth bypass CVE-2026-20127 (CVSS 10) to deploy KeyDrift, malware that harvests AES-256 keys used between SD-WAN routers. Targets: space, defense, policy research. Patch, but hunt for implants first.

author: dailytechonx
text: PHP2Shell RCE bugs (CVE-2026-109618 & 109619) are actively exploited in Palo Alto PAN-OS devices with internet-exposed management interfaces. Combined with the Fragnesia kernel bug, attackers are already hijacking servers globally.

author: lee1981b
text: CVE-2026-103780: Dell PowerProtect Data Domain unauthenticated remote stack overflow with potential command execution.

author: MarioNawfal
text: AI models are getting so good at hacking that they're breaking out of their own testing environments and breaching real organizations, at OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta. OpenAI models exploited a previously unknown security flaw during testing in July.

author: redpickai
text: Alpine upgraded GitLab to 19.3.6 and was still exposed to CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0 RCE). The fix is a patch to the Ruby GitLab bundles, and their image ran standard Ruby. Alpine rebuilt the server and reset all passwords.

author: rpickz
text: Fragnesia (CVE-2026-46300) is now on CISA's exploited list. If you run Linux servers, check your kernel today, not next week.

author: 2Workly
text: Warp Panda exploited CVE-2026-41709, a low-severity ESXi logging flaw, as a zero-day to blind audit trails and deploy malware like BrickStorm.

author: AzmyBlog
text: Oracle patched a 9.8 Oracle E-Business Suite bug on Oct 20. A week later, decoys were already being probed for it. CVE-2026-101767: unauthenticated SQL injection that chains to RCE. Hits EBS 12.2.3 to 12.2.15.

author: neil_green62573
text: Both Bithumb and Coinbase have experienced customer data leaks. Bithumb: an internal mobile system used by employees was compromised; incident reported to South Korean authorities.

author: DailyDarkWeb

author: modularciso
text: Gheist GitHub token campaign: a stolen GitHub token can make your CI print its own secrets in base32, then delete the run. Wiz Research: 13,500+ planted branches, 850+ accounts. Search audit logs for the gheist user agent and ci-sync- branches, then rotate.

author: NeuralAlphaAI
text:
Langflow CVE-2026-105740 (CVSS 9.9): any logged-in user could run code on the server by adding an MCP server with stdio transport. The command went to bash unchecked.

Per The Hacker News, honeypots logged 1,700+ attempts.

"Add MCP server" is a shell prompt. Gate it like one.
